about: Where each boss portrait in public/bosses/ came from. Plot's descriptions are in docs/design/m1-copy.md section 3 (PR #74); Chart's BossBubble draws them at 64 px in Decide's bubbles and up to 96 px on Result, cropped to a rounded square on #1d2440 inside a border in the boss's tint.
by: Orbit, in David's Tripo account at his request
processed: research/station-assets/bosses.py: background found as the color connected to the edges and set to #1d2440 with a soft edge; cropped square around the robot (bust-length; the Commerce Office framed on its front unit, so its copies run off the sides); 256 x 256 webp, quality 88. It reproduces these files byte for byte from Tripo's 1024 x 1024 PNGs.

overall.name: The Station Administrator
overall.tool: Tripo Studio's image generator, model Nano Banana 2 (Gemini), 1:1, one image
overall.prompt: A robot boss character for a cozy retro-futuristic space-station bookshop game: the Station Administrator, a tall thin robot built into a desk-shaped chassis, with one large round glowing orange lens for a face and a mechanical arm holding a clipboard; stiff, slightly too formal posture. Bust-length portrait, facing the viewer, centered with generous margin so nothing touches the corners. Stylized game-ready 3D render: chunky clean shapes, soft bevels, smooth matte surfaces, a strong simple silhouette that stays readable as a tiny icon. Body in dark navy and violet, with one bright orange accent. Plain flat solid dark navy blue background, no gradient, no text, no letters, no logo, no ground shadow.

figures.about: Full-body cutouts of the same five robots for Decide's 2D boss scene (Chart's BossScene2D, bosses.ts `figure`), and the concepts their 3D models are made from, so the 2D and 3D scenes match. Transparent WebP, all 512 px tall on one shared scale with the feet on the bottom edge: a shorter boss has empty space above it and the drone floats, so they can be drawn at one height.
figures.processed: research/station-assets/boss-figures.py: background found as the color connected to the edges (a chroma key for the green one), made transparent with a soft edge, cropped, and scaled to its boss's share of 512 px (Administrator 1.0, Ministry 0.9, Subcommittee 0.86, Commerce Office 0.74, drone 0.34, floating 0.36 up); webp quality 88. It reproduces these files byte for byte from Tripo's PNGs.

overall.tool: Tripo Studio's image generator, model Nano Banana 2 (Gemini), 9:16, one image, with the boss's portrait (research/station-assets/bosses/overall.jpg) as the reference image
overall.prompt: Full-body picture of the same robot character as in the reference image: keep its design, colors, materials and face exactly the same. The Station Administrator: a tall thin robot built into a desk-shaped chassis, with one large round glowing orange lens for a face and a mechanical arm holding a clipboard; stiff, slightly too formal posture. Show the whole robot standing on its base or feet, from the top of its head down to the bottom of its base, turned slightly three-quarter toward the viewer's right. Centered, with a small margin, nothing touching or cut off at the edges. Same stylized game-ready 3D render: chunky clean shapes, soft bevels, smooth matte surfaces. Body in dark navy and violet, with one bright orange accent. Plain flat solid light grey background, no gradient, no floor, no ground shadow, no text, no letters, no logo.
